name: agentscope-desktop
author: SysML team of Alibaba Tongyi Lab

scripts.electron:test: pnpm exec tsc -p electron/tsconfig.test.json && node --test electron-test-dist/tests/backend.test.js
scripts.electron:dev: pnpm electron:compile && concurrently "pnpm frontend:dev" "pnpm exec wait-on http://localhost:5173 && pnpm exec electron ."
scripts.electron:pack: pnpm electron:stage && pnpm exec electron-builder --dir --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.electron:build: pnpm backend:build && pnpm electron:stage && pnpm exec electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
